clips.title: The story
paras: Hamhock is a massive two-headed ogre confined within the depths of the Stormwind Stockade. Locked away beneath the capital alongside hardened Defias insurgents and cutthroats, he looms as a particularly brutal and unexpected inmate amidst the prison riot.

The Stormwind Stockade was built to hold petty thieves, murderers, and political dissidents, making a towering two-headed ogre an imposing sight among the cells. When the prisoners rose up and took control of the facility, Hamhock remained entrenched in the chaos, crushing anyone foolish enough to intrude on his cellblock.

No record explains how Hamhock was captured or why a two-headed ogre was locked away among Stormwind's thieves and dissidents. Whatever brought him to the Stockade, he is now one of its most dangerous inmates.
